title: General product passport (general@2), public payload
description: general@2: the public payload carried on chain in field 10. JSON Schema validity is one check; obligation under a condition (needs-review), units, provenance and legal applicability are separate checks.

notice.description: The sample marker a demonstration record carries first; never product data.

profile.description: The profile identifier the payload declares.

profile_version.description: The profile version the payload declares; a reader decodes under it and never under a newer one.

object_did.description: An optional physical-object DID carried in the public payload; carrying it does not implement physical binding.

dataCarrier.description: The data-carrier identifier (chip UID) the lookup service indexes beside the passport identifier.

name.title: Product name
name.description: required; Nothing requires this. A record with no name is not a passport.

category.title: Kind of object
category.description: required; Nothing requires this. It decides which of the fields below make sense.

manufacturer.title: Maker
manufacturer.description: required; Nothing requires this. On a handbuilt object the maker is the claim.

manufacturerContact.title: How to reach the maker
manufacturerContact.description: required; Nothing requires this. A guarantee nobody can claim against is decoration.

modelIdentifier.title: Model or reference
modelIdentifier.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It is how a maker finds the drawings again.

serialNumber.title: Serial number
serialNumber.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It is the commonest way an object proves it is the one.

manufacturingPlace.title: Where it was made
manufacturingPlace.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. Place is half of provenance.

made.title: Made
made.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. Age is what a durable object is judged on.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It is what a second buyer asks first.

edition.title: Edition
edition.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. On a limited run it is most of the value.

makerName.title: Made by
makerName.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It is the difference between made and manufactured.

authentication.title: How to tell it is the real one
authentication.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It is the question a passport exists to answer.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. The paper certificate, kept where it cannot be lost.

commission.title: Made for
commission.description: optional; Nothing requires this. Published only where the first owner wanted it published.

materials.title: Materials
materials.description: required; Nothing requires this. It is the first thing a repairer needs and the last thing a recycler needs.

method.title: How it was made
method.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It is most of what a buyer is paying for.

notes.title: Anything else worth recording
notes.description: optional; Nothing requires this. It is what keeps a declared profile usable for objects nobody has thought of.

recycledContent.title: Recycled content
recycledContent.description: optional; Nothing requires this. Declared where a maker can substantiate it.

substanceStatement.title: Substances to handle with care
substanceStatement.description: recommended; Nothing requires this here, though REACH Art. 33 may require it of the article itself.

careNote.title: How to look after it
careNote.description: required; Nothing requires this. It is the single field most likely to extend the object’s life.

expectedLifetime.title: Expected lifetime
expectedLifetime.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. A claim made here is one the maker can be held to.

guarantee.title: Guarantee
guarantee.description: recommended; Nothing requires the figure, though a stated commercial guarantee binds the maker.

guaranteeTerms.title: Guarantee terms
guaranteeTerms.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. A term with no conditions attached is not a guarantee.

spareParts.title: Spare parts
spareParts.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It is what decides whether the object outlives its owner.

collection.title: Where to return it
collection.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. A maker who takes it back says so here.

supplyChain.title: Supply chain
supplyChain.description: optional; Nothing requires this. Declared by makers who treat their suppliers as a credential.
